slides.headline: EVERY MATHEMATICIAN ASSUMED THIS WOULD NEVER HAPPEN
slides.body: The Millennium Prize Problems are the seven hardest math problems alive. Unsolved for decades, despite the best mathematicians on Earth. Everyone assumed no machine could touch them. Then today one fell.

slides.headline: AI AGENTS CRACKED THE HARDEST FLUID MATH PROBLEM IN HISTORY
slides.body: The Navier-Stokes problem asks if the equations governing how air, water, and blood move can ever fail. Your blood runs on those equations. Nobody answered it in 90 years. What solved it changes everything.

slides.headline: THE AI ISN'T EVEN OUT YET
slides.body: Built on a model stronger than GPT-6 Astra, which nobody can access.

slides.headline: THE POST HIT 27.7 MILLION VIEWS IN HOURS
slides.body: One of 7 unsolved Millennium Prize Problems, cracked 78K likes, 20K bookmarks in hours 13K reposts, 3.6K replies So what does this break open next?

slides.headline: SOMEWHERE TONIGHT, A MATHEMATICIAN SAW THAT TWEET
slides.body:
They spent decades on this exact problem. AI did it, running on a model nobody can touch yet.

Your hardest business problems deserve this treatment, without hiring anyone.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: OPENAI JUST CRACKED A 90-YEAR MATH PROBLEM

caption:
Swipe to see what AI just did to a math problem that broke every mathematician on Earth for 90 years 🔬

What everyone assumed about machine reasoning, the Navier-Stokes problem and what it actually asks, 90 years of failure ended in one announcement, the model behind it stronger than GPT-6 Astra and not yet released, the virality numbers, the mathematician reading that tweet tonight, and what this means for your business

If AI can solve a problem that stumped every mathematician for 90 years, the argument that any profession requires irreplaceable human depth starts to collapse. Medicine, law, engineering, physics. The only question now is speed.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this means for yours.
